title: LLM4SL: LLM-GNN Collaborative Framework for Synthetic Lethality Prediction
description: Code, data, and trained models for a three-layer collaborative framework integrating LLM weak supervision, GATv2 GNN, and ESM-2 protein language model embeddings for synthetic lethality prediction. 5-fold CV AUC 0.862, Cold-start AUPRC 0.84, DepMap CRISPR validation 1.73x enrichment (p=0.041).
